summary: JAIS requires authors to complete a Generative AI transparency document for every new and revised submission and append it on a separate page to the uploaded cover letter. The page does not explain what AI uses are acceptable, and it says nothing about AI authorship, AI-generated images, or use of AI by reviewers or editors.

evidence.quote: authors must fill out a Generative AI transparency document and append it to the uploaded cover letter on a separate page.
